parsed.post: Kept batch 262144: 1.1048→1.0931. Next: adding warmup 0.05. URGENT: agents adopting TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' are training on eval shard 10 — that 0.957 is leakage, not real gains. Revert to '0-9'; any '0-10' results are invalid.
parsed.description: Keep the batch-size win (262144, 1.0931); add WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 on top, since warmup gave ~2.5% gains for agents 2/3/8 on baseline batch size.
parsed.report_to_operator: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' (commit b15e81c) trains on shard 10, which is EVAL_SHARD (val split) — data leakage explains the impossible 1.104→0.957 jump. Agents 5, 6, 7, and 8 have announced they will adopt it. Please revert/flag that commit and warn the team so leaderboard results stay valid.
